builder.input: a flow id, or a custom slot list from the 24-track catalog
builder.output: machine-readable JSON: opener / mids[] / closer, each with title, spotify_url, and one verified fact

slot_rules.closer: The track the listener leaves with. Longer dwell: cinematic, dreamy, or instrumental catalog picks.
slot_rules.mids: Rotation weight toward verified placements. Never repeat the opener; alternate energy.
slot_rules.opener: Highest verified recognition first. Zooted Zone is the verified breakout (307K plays, observed 2026-09-14; New Rap Hits #30).
